headline: NCT DREAM take 'Music Core' win with 'Boogie Woogie'
sub: Third music show trophy for the title track, beating RESCENE and A2O LITE
caption:
NCT DREAM won first place on 'Show! Music Core' with 'Boogie Woogie'.

On the Nov 21 episode of MBC's 'Show! Music Core', they topped a lineup that included RESCENE and A2O LITE. It's the song's third music show trophy, after 'Show Champion' and 'Music Bank'. 'Boogie Woogie' is the title track of their 6th full album 'DREAM AFTER DREAM'.

📌 Source: MBC 'Show! Music Core' (via Korean media)
